checks.command: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml up --detach --wait --wait-timeout 180 --pull never; docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -U advertified -d advertified -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /opt/advertified/verify-extensions.sql

checks.name: Tracked and non-ignored source secret scan
checks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $scanRoot=Join-Path (Resolve-Path '.artifacts').Path ('gate12-immutable-inputs-gitleaks-replay-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $scanRoot | Out-Null; $files=@(git ls-files -co --exclude-standard); foreach($file in $files){$destination=Join-Path $scanRoot $file; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $destination; if($parent){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null}; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $file -Destination $destination}; gitleaks dir $scanRoot --redact --no-banner --no-color --log-level info; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}"
checks.summary: Gitleaks 8.30.1 returned zero findings from the tracked and non-ignored source mirror.

checks.name: Diff, staging and generated-artifact hygiene
checks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git diff --check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; if(@(git diff --cached --name-only).Count -ne 0){throw 'Staged files found'}; if(@(git ls-files .artifacts artifacts).Count -ne 0){throw 'Tracked artifacts found'}"
checks.summary: No diff-check error, staged file or tracked generated artifact was present.
